liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): The jam at the end of Scarlet is singled out as excellent; Vince plays tastefully, notably in the Scarlet jam where the audience pushes him hard [15][20][21]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): The Stranger opener is described as solid [16]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Reviewer, raised in Michigan and attending as a farewell show, loved hearing Promised Land [19]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): Ended in a wild jam, with Mickey climbing atop a huge drum set and pounding it [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Described as a crazy Other One within a night of long jams between songs [15]

## The recordings

- **gd91-06-19.sbd.aj.2786.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 164 min; rated 4.31/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Known flaws: a splice during Promised Land and noise during Fire On The Mountain [1]
- **gd1991-06-19.149645.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min [7]
- **gd91-06-19.fob-schoeps-mahoney-oneill.miller.28392.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has a well-balanced mix of crowd and band, with everyone audible and the interplay evident [20]
- **gd1991-06-19.109345.sbd.lai.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 162 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [2]

## Around the show

- Pine Knob was a fine venue, somewhat smaller than Deer Creek; a fan afterward called it the tour's best so far [13]
- Pine Knob had recently installed new rigging and sound; the drums segment turned into virtuosic percussion and keyboard work [19]
- Very hot day with a scorching tar parking lot, but cool grass on the hill [22]
- Clouds reportedly cleared as Scarlet>Fire began, and everyone looked up at the sky [22]
- Felt like a quiet letdown after the powerful second night at Giants Stadium [13]
- Reviewer finds this audience tape a good companion to their somewhat lifeless soundboard copy [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-06-19.sbd.aj.2786.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC > CDWav (retrack) > CD [1]. Also: Reviewer says they just transferred a front-of-board copy of this show; Soundboard went through DAT, cassette, DAT, CD and WAV, then was retracked by Ivan Kotch and sent to etree by Adam Jerugim [1][14]
- **gd1991-06-19.149645.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 17, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [7]. Also: Patch source came from James Young, Clay Brennecke, Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell [7]
- **gd91-06-19.fob-schoeps-mahoney-oneill.miller.28392.sbeok.shnf**: taped by JC Mahoney, Dan O'Neill; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Audience: AKG 461's [9]
- **gd1991-06-19.109345.sbd.lai.shnf**: source: SBD>CM>DAT>SHN>CD; edited and transferred to cd by michael lai [2]
